segments.source: La inteligencia artificial en el cine parece algo actual, pero, desde que en el año 1902 se estrenó «Viaje a la luna» (primera película de ciencia ficción),en el cine se han desarrollado una gran cantidad de películas en las que la inteligencia artificial está involucrada. Para el gran público, las tramas que giran en torno a máquinas, robots y derivados siempre son de gran interés, habiéndose creado con el tiempo una serie de personajes icónicos.
segments.en: Artificial intelligence in cinema seems current, but, since "Journey to the Moon" (the first science fiction film) was released in 1902, a large number of films have been developed in cinema in which artificial intelligence is involved. For the general public, plots that revolve around machines, robots and derivatives are always of great interest, having created a series of iconic characters over time.

segments.en: . And to reassure you, no, exterminating robots or killer AIs do not exist and are far from it, machines that think for themselves with the aim of achieving their own benefit is a reality that is successful in the world of cinema but that in the real world has no scope (at the moment). Although on the other hand, it must be said that AI has changed our lives and that is indeed a reality.
